targets.title: Professors’ perceptions of student behaviors.
targets.evidence_quote: This study is a replication and extension of the work completed by Parr and Valerius (1999), who based their work on the Student Behaviors Questionnaire by Brozo and Schmelzer (1985).
targets.outcome_quote: The top 10 ratings for appropriateness and frequency differed from previous work.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The central rank order findings differed; discussion explicitly says the two top-ten results do not match. Partial item overlap does not itself establish a mixed verdict. The expanded item pool complicates interpretation.

reasoning: New national sample re-tests and explicitly compares faculty ratings with Parr and Valerius; Brozo and Schmelzer supplied the earlier questionnaire rather than the immediate target.
